library(readxl)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)
# Load data
file_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "5 groups")
# Build list of sets
sets <- list(
  A = na.omit(df$A),
  B = na.omit(df$B),
  C = na.omit(df$C),
  D = na.omit(df$D),
  E = na.omit(df$E)
)
# Configure CJK font
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = "PingFang SC"))
# Compute proportional Venn diagram using ggVennDiagram
# Using "weuler" which is an area-proportional euler-like diagram
venn <- Venn(sets)
plot_data <- process_data(venn)
# Create the proportional Venn diagram
p <- ggplot(plot_data) +
  # Area proportional geometry
  geom_polygon(
    aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y, group = .data$id, fill = .data$id),
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Set labels
  geom_text(
    aes(x = .data$x_label, y = .data$y_label, label = .data$label),
    data = dplyr::filter(plot_data@label, .data$tag == "set"),
    size = 6,
    family = "PingFang SC",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Region count labels
  geom_text(
    aes(x = .data$x_count, y = .data$y_count, label = .data$count),
    data = dplyr::filter(plot_data@label, .data$tag == "count"),
    size = 4,
    family = "PingFang SC"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_void(base_family = "PingFang SC") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "5-set synthetic Venn diagram",
    subtitle = paste0("Total unique: ", length(union(union(union(union(sets$A, sets$B), sets$C), sets$D), sets$E)))
  )
# Save to PNG
ggsave("proportional_venn_5sets.png", p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved: proportional_venn_5sets.png\n")
file.info("proportional_venn_5sets.png")[c("size", "isdir")]

library(readxl)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)
# Load data
file_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "5 groups")
# Build list of sets (drop NA)
sets <- list(
  A = na.omit(df$A),
  B = na.omit(df$B),
  C = na.omit(df$C),
  D = na.omit(df$D),
  E = na.omit(df$E)
)
# Configure CJK font for macOS
font_family <- "PingFang SC"
# Use ggVennDiagram with proportional area approximation
# label_alpha=0 hides region labels for empty intersections (none here)
p <- ggVennDiagram(
  sets,
  set_size = 5,
  label_alpha = 0,
  label = "count",
  label_size = 4
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4FAFE", high = "#4981BF") +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep("black", length(sets))) +
  theme_void(base_family = font_family) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold", family = font_family),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, family = font_family)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "5-set synthetic Venn diagram (Proportional Venn Diagram)",
    subtitle = "Area approximately reflects set size · Area ~ set size (euler approximation)"
  ) +
  coord_fixed()
# Make labels CJK-friendly
p$layers[[2]]$aes_params$family <- font_family
p$layers[[3]]$aes_params$family <- font_family
# Save
ggsave("proportional_venn_5sets.png", p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved: proportional_venn_5sets.png\n")
cat("File size:", file.info("proportional_venn_5sets.png")$size, "bytes\n")
